scenes.headline: How linear attention forgets, like an isotope
scenes.sub: Kimi Delta Attention's per-channel decay, and the half-life it implies.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Fizz! Kimi Delta Attention forgets in exactly the way a radioactive isotope decays. Here's the math, and why it matters.

scenes.text: Each KDA channel keeps a fixed fraction α of its state per token, so it has a half-life measured in tokens.
scenes.say: Each channel keeps a fixed fraction, alpha, of its memory per token. That's radioactive decay, so every channel has a half-life, measured in tokens.

scenes.title: Two spellings of one law
scenes.text: α^n = e^(−λn),   n½ = ln 0.5 / ln α
scenes.say: Strip the recurrence to its decay term.

parts.note: keep a fraction α, n tokens in a row
parts.say: Keep a fraction alpha, n tokens in a row.

parts.note: the isotope's law, with λ = −ln α
parts.say: That's the isotope's law, with lambda equal to minus log alpha.

parts.note: solve for half the signal gone
parts.say: Solve for half the signal gone, and you get the half-life in tokens.

scenes.title: Half-life in tokens, by α
scenes.note: each additional nine buys another factor of ten
scenes.say: The lever is brutally nonlinear near one. Alpha point nine nine gives about sixty-nine tokens. Point nine nine nine gives about six hundred ninety-three.

steps.label: Per-channel α: a spectrum of timescales
steps.note: the fastest allowed: a half-life of about 0.14 tokens
steps.say: In K3, alpha is per channel, so one head holds a whole spectrum of half-lives. Fast channels act like a local window; slow ones, like a running summary of the context.

scenes.title: Where the decay lives in Kimi K3

steps.say: Kimi K3 stacks three KDA layers for every Gated MLA layer. Sixty-nine of its ninety-three layers run this decay.
The full-attention layer is the periodic anchor for exact recall.

scenes.text: A decay factor is a timescale: the half-life turns an opaque gate into a number of tokens you can check.

recap: A channel keeps α per token: exponential decay
Half-life is ln 0.5 / ln α tokens
K3 learns a spread of half-lives per head
scenes.say: To recap: decay by a fixed fraction, a half-life in tokens, and a spectrum of them in every head.
